verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada is a digital filing and registry service that holds corporate data, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only incorporation steps, fees, annual returns, email change notices and certificate ordering, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions. The open.canada.ca API probe concerns the national open-data layer, not AI features in the registry itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
